metadata.case_name: CHAN YU CHAU v. FONG ON CONSTRUCTION & ENGINEERING CO. LTD. [2002]

injuries.description: amputation of the right thumb at the proximal phalangeal joint
source: amputation of the right thumb at the proximal phalangeal joint
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic amputation of thumb

injuries.description: amputation of the right index finger at the metacarpo phalangeal joint
source: amputation of the right index finger at the metacarpo phalangeal joint
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

injuries.description: amputation of the right middle finger at the proximal phalangeal joint
source: amputation of the right middle finger at the proximal phalangeal joint
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation of other single finger

manifestations.description: his right hand has only about 1/3 of the power grip of the left hand
He cannot make a pincer grip for fine finger manipulation of an object with his right hand.
His ability in hammering and nailing is affected as he cannot hold a hammer tightly during hammering.
He can no longer use chopsticks with his right hand.
The injuries seriously affect his ability to write
He complains of not being able to tie his shoelaces
embarrassment when people look at his right hand when he walks in the street
the use he now makes of his right hand is to assist his left hand with which he performs all major tasks
it affects his mood leading him to lose his temper more easily

treatments_received.treatment: emergency operation in an attempt to restore the severed digits
source: An emergency operation was conducted in an attempt to restore the severed digits but subsequently they became gangrenous.

treatments_received.treatment: operation on 1998-03-17 to remove the amputated digits
source: A further operation was conducted on 17 March 1998 to remove the amputated digits.
Thereafter he received the physiotherapy and occupational therapy.
Thereafter he received the physiotherapy and occupational therapy.
